summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on September 2, 2026, to disclose transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMRs), specifically the grant of share awards to its Chief Financial Officer, Dragos Constantinescu. The awards include unrestricted shares and restricted share plan awards, priced at £41.29 per share, with volumes totaling 26,345 shares. These grants replace long-term incentives forfeited from a previous employer and were transacted on September 1, 2026. The filing is a routine disclosure under UK market rules, constituting a standard PDMR notification with no special-situation implications.
